positions.title: Software Engineer (Internship)
positions.description:
● Parsed and analyzed service logs to identify server traffic patterns in collaboration with data scientist 
● Developed Stress Testing programs to evaluate and test S3 storage host, platform, and web server 
● Constructed event-driven REST APIs that monitored the traffic, identified the threshold of performance degradation, and alerted S3 storage hosts to trigger automated scaling, resulting in operational cost savings of hundreds of millions of dollars 
● Deployed applications leveraging AWS Lambda and Amazon S3 with the Cloud Development Kit (CDK) 
● Packaged the programs as command-line APIs for seamless execution within the production code library 
● Created unit test and integration test and Automated program execution through cron job implementation
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Lambda · AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · Amazon S3 · Cloud Development · Amazon CloudWatch

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Processed, aggregated, and enriched data using SQL (Teradata) to meet product requirements and support data analysis 
● Developed back-end programs for core banking products including Save, Loan, Investment leveraging Hibernate and Spring Boot 
● Created web applications for data visualization via Flask, TypeScript, and JavaScript 
● Deployed services using Docker and Kubernetes to enhance infrastructure management and scalability

● Developed ETL pipelines to synthesize raw data from multiple sources into one data warehouse

* Create financial database and develop trading strategy from scratch
- Get Market Data via python web scraping library 
- Design an automatic data pipeline to load raw data into database 
- Write scripts to schedule tasks on GCP 
- Design back testing code
- Build dashboard via Elasticsearch & Kibana

positions.title: Product Specialist
positions.description:
91 APP is an e-commerce solution provider that allows anyone to set up an online store on web/APP.
* Leverage the company's product or solution (e-commerce platform services including website, app, in-store integration software, payment, customized marketing function) to enhance clients' revenue
- Analyze sales data of clients to find composition of customer group 
- Discuss with clients to find pain points
- Recommend multiple marketing solution for clients in accordance with their customer segmentation 
- Design A/B testing to optimize marketing strategy

projects.title: twquant
projects.description:
Twquant is a framework which aims for quant investment. It has been released on pypi (you can do pip install twquant). The current focus is stock selecting. Main functions are as follows.
Retrieve raw data by web scraping and turn raw data into formatted data.
Combine various source of data and get the whole picture.
Calculate yearly return after addressing price adjustment in given time period.
Backtesting - import specific criteria and calculate correspondent yearly return.
code on github : https://reurl.cc/4ReO1R
explanation on medium : https://reurl.cc/L3nqVX
